regime_context: Policy regime is low-real-yield engineering plus re-industrialization, but the realized state is a stagflationary split: hot PCE and a collapsing ceasefire forced a hawkish Fed majority (>70% Sept hike) even while the administration wants lower real yields without the optics of cuts. Consensus reads a coordinated Warsh-Bessent plan; revealed preference shows aligned incentives, not coordination — inflation-mandate credibility is being banked first, and any easing is post-midterm optionality, not a committed path.
regime_context_zh: 政策体制是低实际利率工程叠加再工业化，但已实现的状态是滞胀式分裂：PCE偏高、停火破裂迫使市场对美联储9月加息的概率升至70%以上，而政府既想降低实际利率、又不想承受降息的表观信号。市场共识将其读作Warsh与Bessent的协同计划；但显示性偏好表明只是激励一致、并非协同——先储备通胀使命的可信度，任何宽松都是中期选举后的可选路径，而非承诺路径。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The ceasefire collapse (7/8) and US strikes on Iran re-prime the energy rotation that already made XLE the top ETF-inflow sector in Q1; headline-fragile but the flow is real and oil is upside-skewed on further escalation.
theses.thesis_zh: 7月8日停火破裂与美军对伊朗打击重新激活能源板块轮动，XLE本已是Q1 ETF资金流入最多的行业；虽然对头条敏感，但资金流真实存在，且若冲突进一步升级，油价上行风险更大。
evidence: Iran / Middle East theater: ceasefire COLLAPSED as of 7/8, Brent spiked ~$80 intraday
Energy was the TOP ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026
Capital: oil two-sided but upside-skewed on headlines — rotation now re-primed
theses.dissent: A quick re-ceasefire or de-escalation would unwind the spike; plus oil is headline-fragile and the current Brent level may already price the realized escalation.
theses.dissent_zh: 若迅速达成新的停火或局势降级，油价涨幅会回吐；且能源对头条高度敏感，当前Brent水平可能已计入已实现的升级。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY from today through the next 60 trading days despite no new Hormuz disruption
falsifier.text_zh: 在未来60个交易日内，尽管没有新的霍尔木兹中断，XLE仍跑输SPY

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: Market now prices >70% Sept hike and Warsh held the hawkish line at Sintra; with real 10y at 2.29% and the Fed banking inflation-mandate credibility first, long-duration is the wrong side until labor-crack data reopens an easing path.
theses.thesis_zh: 市场对9月加息概率定价超过70%，Warsh在Sintra上维持鹰派立场；10年期实际利率达2.29%，美联储优先储备通胀使命可信度，在就业裂缝数据重新打开宽松路径之前，长端久期处于错误的一侧。
evidence: Warsh Sintra: 'prices are too high'; declined to signal July; buried forward guidance
Open prediction: Fed does NOT cut at July and September
theses.dissent: Bessent's structural yield suppression (bill-heavy issuance, buybacks, dealer reform) caps long yields from below, and the June payrolls crack (+57k) is exactly the catalyst that can reopen an easing path into fall.
theses.dissent_zh: Bessent的结构性收益率压制（偏重短债发行、回购、交易商改革）从下方限制长端收益率，且6月非农裂缝（+57k）正是可能在秋季重新打开宽松路径的催化剂。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 5% or more before the check-by date without a Sept hike being priced out
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日前，TLT跑赢SPY达5%或以上，且9月加息并未被市场排除

theses.subject: KBE
theses.thesis: Regional-bank proxy KBE was a recent miss (realized -0.082) and the dealer-bank thesis depends on eSLR reform and Treasury clearing progress that remains only 'proposed' without a concrete rule; a hike-majority curve is not yet a confirmed tailwind.
theses.thesis_zh: 地区银行代理KBE近期已验证为失误（实现收益-0.082），而交易商银行逻辑依赖的eSLR改革与国债中央清算进展仍停留在“提议”阶段，尚无具体规则出台；加息占优的收益率曲线尚不能确认为顺风。
evidence: Track record: KBE overweight 2026-07-10 was a miss, realized -0.0818
Open prediction: eSLR-reform progress is a proposed/final rule — not yet confirmed
Open prediction: SEC advances Treasury central-clearing expansion — milestone, not done
Backdrop: >70% Sept hike probability steepens pressure on regional funding
theses.dissent: If the Fed and Treasury deliver a concrete eSLR final rule and clearing expansion, dealer banks re-rate vs SPY; front-end bill-heavy issuance also structurally favors intermediation volumes.
theses.dissent_zh: 若美联储与财政部推出具体的eSLR最终规则和清算扩展，交易商银行将相对SPY重估；偏重短债的发行结构也有利于中介交易量。

falsifier.text: KBE outperforms SPY by 5% or more before the check-by date without a concrete eSLR final rule or clearing milestone
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日前，KBE跑赢SPY达5%或以上，且并无具体的eSLR最终规则或清算里程碑出现

theses.subject: SMR
theses.thesis: Nuclear-for-AI is a real rotation, but SMR was a recent miss (-0.166) and its small-cap reactor complex is headline-fragile and not yet anchored by contracted/sited projects; the policy catalyst ledger remains in DOE/HALEU proposal stage rather than signed capacity.
theses.thesis_zh: 核能服务AI是真实轮动主题，但SMR近期已验证为失误（-0.166），其小盘反应堆组合对头条敏感，且尚未获得已签约/选址项目的支撑；政策催化清单仍停留在DOE/HALEU燃料库提案阶段，而非已签约产能。
evidence: Track record: SMR overweight 2026-07-10 was a miss, realized -0.1656
Open prediction: DOE releases ≥20 MT HALEU — not yet confirmed
Open prediction: AI/critical-infrastructure reactor program shows a contracted/sited project — not yet confirmed
Rotation theme: Nuclear · uranium · HALEU/fuel cycle is FACT mechanism but INFERENCE proxies
theses.dissent: If DOE confirms a large HALEU release and a contracted reactor project is announced, early-stage SMR names can re-rate rapidly and overshoot the large-cap nuclear complex.
theses.dissent_zh: 若DOE确认大规模HALEU释放并宣布已签约反应堆项目，早期SMR标的可能快速重估并超越大型核能板块。

falsifier.text: SMR outperforms SPY by 10% or more before the check-by date without a confirmed DOE release or sited project
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日前，SMR跑赢SPY达10%或以上，且并无确认的DOE释放或已选址项目

theses.subject: SHLD
theses.thesis: Defense is a structural NATO-driven super-cycle with 'targeted/high-confidence' capital, and the Iran re-escalation adds a kinetic driver on top of budget commitments; SHLD (defense-tech prime proxy) is a cleaner expression than ITA, which was a recent miss.
theses.thesis_zh: 国防是北约驱动的结构性超级周期，资金面被标记为“定向/高置信度”，伊朗冲突再升级在预算承诺之外又增加了实战驱动；SHLD（国防科技主承包商代理）比近期失手的ITA表达更纯粹。
evidence: NATO / Defense theater: structural spending super-cycle — 'Targeted/high-confidence'
Proxies include SHLD alongside ITA, XAR, PPA
Iran escalation realized: US strikes 7/8–11, defense bid persists regardless of oil path
Track record: ITA overweight was a miss, realized -0.108
theses.dissent: Defense primes can underperform vs broad SPY in a risk-on AI-led tape if the Iran situation de-escalates and budget headlines dominate; ITA's recent miss shows defense flows are not automatic.
theses.dissent_zh: 若伊朗局势降级且AI驱动的风险偏好行情占优，国防主承包商可能跑输SPY；ITA近期失手表明国防资金流入并非自动发生。

falsifier.text: SHLD lags SPY by 5% or more before the check-by date despite the NATO budget commitment remaining intact
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日前，尽管北约预算承诺保持不变，SHLD仍跑输SPY达5%或以上
